about: Ottawa is Canada’s capital, in eastern Ontario on the Ottawa River across from Gatineau, Québec. Federal government, national museums, and bilingual public life shape the city. Neighbourhoods range from Parliament Hill and the ByWard Market to suburban communities along the river. About 1 million people live in the city.
seoSummary: Canada’s capital on the Ottawa River, with Parliament Hill and national museums.
